title: Known differences of one native application
description: NT-03: what an application shows differently from OPF's preview when it opens OPF's PPTX export, as records. The records with skill: true are the rows of the generated table in skills/opf-export/SKILL.md, in file order.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this record shape.

target.description: The application the records describe, by the name its driver uses.

records.description: The known differences, in table order.

version.description: A pair of versions: the application's and the OPF release whose export it opened.

application.description: The application's version as it names itself (Keynote 16.0 is "16.0").

opf.description: The OPF release that wrote the file.

place.description: One slide of a round's decks that shows the difference.

deck.description: The deck's name in the round (a corpus file name such as coverage-charts, or a round deck such as m-charts).

variant.description: The export variant the slide was opened in: default, native (--body-text native) or static (--slide-numbers static). Absent means default.

id.description: A stable id, never reused for another difference.

title.description: What the deck has: the first column of the skill table.

feature.description: The area of the format the difference belongs to.

sees.description: What a user sees in the application: the second column of the skill table.

workaround.description: What to do: the third column of the skill table; null when there is nothing to say.

whose.description: Who would change for the difference to go: OPF's file, OPF's importer, the application (the file is valid and it reads it differently), or OPF's preview.

grade.description: How much it matters: small (looks different, nothing lost or misplaced) or wrong (lost, misplaced or misleading).

where.description: Slides of the rounds that show it. Empty only when scope is set or located is false.

located.description: false when the difference is recorded but no deck and slide of the rounds shows it (where is then empty). Absent means true.

scope.description: For a difference not tied to a slide: every deck shows it, or every deck in the default theme.

warning.description: The application's import-warning text this record explains, one string per line.

firstSeen.description: The first application and OPF versions a round saw it in.

lastSeen.description: The last application and OPF versions a round saw it in.

issue.description: The issue that tracks it, or null.

finding.description: The id a round gave it (MX-03, LG-02 ...).

skill.description: true: a row of the generated table in skills/opf-export/SKILL.md.

status.description: open while the latest round shows it; retired when a later round no longer does.

note.description: What a later round changed or narrowed, kept beside the table text it does not rewrite.
